caption_claim: Initialization sensitivity is assessed within basins using function-level evidence; epoch churn reports finite-budget stability.
supported_manuscript_claims: Initialization sensitivity is assessed within basins using function-level evidence; epoch churn reports finite-budget stability.
limitations: 12 prespecified new basins, three fixed seeds; sample size is 12, not 36.
Near-threshold gates and churn describe finite-epoch sensitivity; not proof of convergence.
CKA centered in FP64 after first-row translation; undefined constant representations are excluded from plotting and counted explicitly.

caption_claim: Median and interquartile training/validation loss across 521 primary basins under the fixed three-phase budget.
supported_manuscript_claims: Median and interquartile training/validation loss across 521 primary basins under the fixed three-phase budget.
limitations: Bands are between-basin IQR, not confidence intervals.
Stage-II training uses dynamic sparsity; validation evaluates the final sparsity budget.
Finite loss curves do not prove structural convergence.

caption_claim: Full test hydrographs at a disclosed median-performance example and the retained LSTM extreme case.
supported_manuscript_claims: Full test hydrographs at a disclosed median-performance example and the retained LSTM extreme case.
limitations: Illustrations are descriptive, not a random sample or evidence of universal superiority.
Median example selected after performance aggregation; tie broken by basin ID.
Station08190500 was identified before final STEH analysis; no test-driven retraining or clipping.

caption_claim: Unfiltered input-derived proxy decodability compared between trained hidden states and input history.
supported_manuscript_claims: Unfiltered input-derived proxy decodability compared between trained hidden states and input history.
limitations: CUM/API/CHG are input-derived rainfall proxies. Probe R2 measures decodability; not evidence of independent physical states or causality. Negative values, undefined scores and failures retained.
Frozen unfiltered probe scores imported and count/status/source checked; hidden/sample forecasts not saved, so R2 was not independently recomputed.
Probes fit on a fixed training subset and evaluate a fixed held-out test subset; not all daily forecasts.

caption_claim: Continuous descriptive associations of retained unit counts with skill across all 521 basins per setting.
supported_manuscript_claims: Continuous descriptive associations of retained unit counts with skill across all 521 basins per setting.
limitations: No causal effect of compactness is established.
Validation-based core selection can mechanically couple core size and performance.
All negative and extreme NSE values retained; no NSE=0.5 grouping or outlier exclusion.
